cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: 8-digit CPV codes (e.g. 72000000 = IT services). Parent codes also match child codes.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: ISO alpha-2 (FI) or alpha-3 (FIN) country codes.

countryField.title: Country matches
countryField.description: Filter by contracting authority (buyer) country or place of performance country.

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: Groups: competition, planning, award, change - or raw TED notice types (cn-standard, can-standard, ...).

publishedFrom.title: Published from (YYYY-MM-DD)
publishedFrom.description: Start of publication date window (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 7 days ago (or since last run in alert mode).

publishedTo.title: Published to (YYYY-MM-DD)
publishedTo.description: End of publication date window (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of deduplicated tender notices to return per run.

language.title: Preferred title language
language.description: ISO 639-2/B code: eng, fin, swe, deu, fra ...

collapseByProcedure.title: Collapse by procedure
collapseByProcedure.description: Keep only the newest notice per procurement procedure.

alertMode.title: Alert mode (only new notices)
alertMode.description: Return only notices not seen in previous runs with the same alert key. Schedule the actor daily.

alertStateKey.title: Alert key
alertStateKey.description: Separate alert states for different saved searches.
